name: contraturno
description: Contraturno: plataforma editorial colectiva, crítica y open source sobre Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1.

scripts.dev:local-db: wrangler d1 migrations apply contraturno-db --local && wrangler pages dev public --compatibility-date=2025-05-15 --no-show-interactive-dev-session
scripts.check: node --check public/app.js && node --check functions/api/register.js && node --check functions/api/posts.js && node --check functions/api/comments.js && node --check functions/api/report.js && node --check functions/api/profile.js && node --check functions/api/schema.js
